Biden cannot force private businesses to mandate the vaccine or weekly testing. It will worsen current labor shortages & the supply chain crisis. 

RT if you agree - Americans should make their own health choices, not be mandated by the government!

Chicago Teachers Union at it again – relentless in keeping schools closed after we’ve seen negative impacts like learning loss and increased mental health issues.
 
Students > unions
https://t.co/87lYwGakCy

BREAKING: #SCOTUS Blocks Biden's Vaccine Mandate! This ruling is a win for America’s workers, businesses, and economy. OSHA is not a public health agency, and I’m proud to have led the fight against this mandate at the congressional level. https://t.co/zQzRfDb7pV

It’s not too much to ask capable Georgians on Medicaid to engage in education or work. Proud to have joined my GA Republican colleagues in the House in opposing the Biden Administration’s decision to deny Georgia’s proposal to provide Medicaid coverage. https://t.co/eNSRNUw0t0

Socializing health care will diminish the quality of care, eliminate choice and ultimately increase costs. In my latest for @WashTimes, I explain how @HouseGOP remain focused on crafting solutions that will actually lower health care costs and drug prices. https://t.co/SAxjMA5EJQ
See my opinion piece in @WashTimes on how to improve healthcare here ⬇️

Students' mental health should not be a partisan issue.

After committee Democrats decided to go it alone on this matter, I offered an amendment during yesterday's @EdLaborGOP markup to ensure mental health grant funds are spent wisely and parents are kept in the loop.

WATCH ⬇️ https://t.co/5oMEjJKnP1

I have long supported proactive measures to fund school security and mental health services, but combining these common-sense measures with policies that would disarm law-abiding Americans makes this package unacceptable. (1/3)
Proud of our work on the Healthy Future Task Force developing solutions to make health care more affordable.

ICYMI: @repkevinhern, @RepSpartz and I penned an opinion piece on solutions to make health care more affordable. 
Check it out here: https://t.co/qfsiogKwrd

I joined @repkevinhern and @RepSpartz in hosting a roundtable to hear directly from small businesses around the country on how we can make health care more affordable. Thanks to the @NFIB for a great discussion!
https://t.co/JPo8hMlwJx

I attended the annual Congressional Luncheon hosted by the @GAChamber where I spoke about economic recovery and the need for increased access to affordable health care, especially for our underserved rural communities. #GCCL22 https://t.co/zvrYfQSPtA

It was great to visit the headquarters of Laurens County Emergency Medical Services and speak with several EMS directors about the ongoing ambulance shortage.

I believe that emergency medical service providers deliver essential care to communities and help save lives. https://t.co/dVK55hhD5m

House Democrats want to give the Labor Department $275M to enforce “mental health parity,” a term they have not clearly defined.

I offered an amendment to strike this funding and provide additional guidance on what this means, but the majority party rejected it. Twice. https://t.co/BsQEELPhCk
Happy #Diwali to all celebrating the Festival of Lights! May this time of celebration bring health and happiness to you and your family.

House Republicans are fighting to expand healthcare options, make it easier to personalize your care, and reduce costs through transparency and competition. 

That is our #CommitmentToAmerica.

I was encouraged to see that, this week, @GovKemp and @TCSG announced the creation of 120 new apprenticeships to train workers in high-demand fields like healthcare, manufacturing, and construction.

https://t.co/JnOhAXITKw

.@HouseGOP is using the Congressional Review Act, or CRA, to exercise our oversight authority and protect your hard-earned savings. The CRA is just one tool in the toolbox we’re using to hold this administration accountable for their damaging policies.
Please join Robin and me in praying for a speedy recovery for our dear friend and Majority Leader @SteveScalise as he undergoes treatment. #TeamScalise

The Lower Costs, More Transparency Act delivers much-needed price transparency throughout the health care system.

H.R. 5378 requires timely and accurate information about the cost of care, treatment, and hospital services to be disclosed to consumers. https://t.co/v8oywUvnoY

In honor of #NationalSchoolChoiceWeek, yesterday I visited A.R. Johnson Health Science and Engineering Magnet School in Augusta!

Quick recap:
💻 Rocket building presentation
🚀 Successful rocket launch
👩‍⚕️ Blood pressure and CPR demonstration

Read more⤵️
https://t.co/VFoXIPOdyW

Tremendous visit today at Emanuel Medical Center in Swainsboro—providing rural communities in #GA12 with quality care close to home.

Thank you for having me and for the invaluable update on the hospital's successes and challenges! https://t.co/QPnfAt1keB

Despite the challenges facing rural health care, Candler County Hospital continues to focus on quality care for each and every patient.

I enjoyed touring the hospital today to see firsthand the recent technology upgrades, improvements in infrastructure, and the dedicated staff who provide the best possible patient experience.

Congratulations to my friend @RepGuthrie on being selected as the next Chair of @HouseCommerce! 

I look forward to working under your leadership to deliver America first policies that lower energy costs, improve transparency in health care, and combat Communist China.

I am honored to serve as the Chairman of the @EdWorkforceCmte's Subcommittee on Health, Employment, Labor, and Pensions.

With forty years of experience building and operating a small business, I am well aware of how federal policies impact the livelihoods of job creators and workers alike.

Thank you, @RepWalberg, for entrusting me with this role!

https://t.co/qfQ0LiNZM6
